Figure 1: Overview of ADORE. Each round consists of three stages: Adapt generates corpus-calibrated pseudopassages conditioned on structured feedback from prior rounds, Observe retrieves documents from the target corpus, and Evaluate assesses the results to produce structured feedback for the next iteration.
